messages.subject: History file
messages.body_plain:
Due to some unfortunate network issues I have, my connection to the
server is often lost.

I can reconnect to my rjserver session and continue, which is great.
However, I lose all my history... which makes it hard to figure out
where I left off if I was in the middle of exploration.

I have tried messing with some of my .Rprofile settings and poking
around StatET settings, but I haven't figured out how to preserve my
history after reconnect.

Does anyone have advice?

Thanks in advance,
Scott

messages.subject: Re: History file
messages.body_plain:
Hi Scott,

which history do you mean? Which part is lost?

Do you know the "History / Transcript" feature configurable in the R 
console launch config?
It may be also helpful to disable the Eclipse option "Remove terminated 
launches when a new launch is created" in the preferences (Run Debug > 
Launching).

Regards,
Stephan
